Specification: This module specifies algorithm AB2, a two-party alternating-bit style communication protocol with lossy channels. Process A sends messages consisting of a data value paired with a bit, process B returns acknowledgments containing the bit, and a separate LoseMsgs process nondeterministically removes messages from either channel to model message loss. The specification includes the PlusCal algorithm and its generated TLA+ translation, defines the initial state and next-state relation, and verifies behavior with the temporal specification Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars without additional fairness or proof obligations.
